description: Burgundy floor-length gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and narrow gold patterned borders. A decorated belt closes at the waist. A cream patterned wrap rests around the forearms and a light inner skirt shows at the front. A brown decorated shoe is visible beneath the hem. Small earrings and a thin bracelet are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons.
